subject.title: [Feature]: Plugin API for aborting agent runs (api.runtime.agent.abort)

question: Should OpenClaw expose `api.runtime.agent.abort({ runId })` to plugins, and what ownership/session authority must gate that abort?
rationale: The implementation shape is blocked on whether plugins may terminate runs by opaque run id, or whether cancellation should stay behind Gateway/session-run-cancel surfaces with stricter ownership binding.

options.title: Design A Scoped Runtime API
options.body: Approve a plugin runtime abort method only after defining session/plugin ownership, permission checks, response shape, SDK docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Use Existing Gateway/Session Cancel Seams
options.body: Keep plugin runtime unchanged and direct plugin authors toward `sessions.abort`, `chat.abort`, or a reviewed session-run-cancel SDK seam instead.

options.title: Reject Plugin Abort Authority
options.body: Document that plugins cannot directly cancel arbitrary agent runs and require owner-specific cancellation to remain internal or Gateway-scoped.

recommendation.title: Design A Scoped Runtime API
recommendation.body: Approve a plugin runtime abort method only after defining session/plugin ownership, permission checks, response shape, SDK docs, and compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest overlap across PluginRuntime helpers, SDK docs, and Gateway abort behavior.
